topQueriesAllPhases.query: SELECT "public"."territory_block"."id", "public"."territory_block"."registration_status", "public"."territory_block"."block_id", "public"."territory_block"."territory_id", "public"."territory_block"."signature_id", "public"."territory_block"."tenant_id" FROM "public"."territory_block" WHERE ("public"."territory_block"."tenant_id" = $1 AND "public"."territory_block"."territory_id" = $2 AND "public"."territory_block"."block_id" = $3 AND "public"."territory_block"."registration_status" <> $4) LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6

SELECT "public"."house"."id", "public"."house"."number", "public"."house"."legend", "public"."house"."dont_visit", "public"."house"."complement", "public"."house"."order", "public"."house"."address_id", "public"."house"."block_id", "public"."house"."registration_status", "public"."house"."territory_block_address_id" FROM "public"."house" WHERE ("public"."house"."tenant_id" = $1 AND "public"."house"."territory_id" = $2 AND "public"."house"."block_id" IN ($3) AND "public"."house"."registration_status" <> $4 AND "public"."house"."number" <> $5 AND ("public"."house"."territory_block_address_id" IS NULL OR "public"."house"."territory_block_address_id" IN ($6,$7,$8))) OFFSET $9

SELECT "public"."signature"."id", "public"."signature"."can_edit_structure", "public"."signature"."key", "public"."signature"."expiration_date", "public"."signature"."token", "public"."signature"."tenant_id" FROM "public"."signature" WHERE ("public"."signature"."key" = $1 AND "public"."signature"."tenant_id" = $2 AND "public"."signature"."expiration_date" > $3) LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5

INSERT INTO field_session(tenant_id,territory_id,round_number,block_id,address_id,client_id,tab_id,signature_key) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,client_id,tab_id) WHERE disconnected_at IS NULL DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at=now()

SELECT DISTINCT fs.client_id,fs.block_id,fs.address_id FROM field_session fs JOIN signature s ON s.key=fs.signature_key AND s.tenant_id=fs.tenant_id WHERE fs.tenant_id=$1 AND fs.territory_id=$2 AND fs.round_number=$3 AND fs.last_seen_at>now()-interval $5 AND fs.disconnected_at IS NULL AND s.expiration_date>now() AND fs.block_id=$4

SELECT "public"."territory"."id", "public"."territory"."name", "public"."territory"."tenant_id", "public"."territory"."type_id", "public"."territory"."image_url" FROM "public"."territory" WHERE ("public"."territory"."id" = $1 AND "public"."territory"."tenant_id" = $2) LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
SELECT round_number,revision FROM field_revision WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND territory_id=$2 AND block_id=$3 AND round_number IN (0,$4)

SELECT "public"."round_info"."id", "public"."round_info"."status", "public"."round_info"."type_ids", "public"."round_info"."started_at", "public"."round_info"."closed_at", "public"."round_info"."round_number", "public"."round_info"."name", "public"."round_info"."theme", "public"."round_info"."tenant_id", "public"."round_info"."color_primary", "public"."round_info"."color_secondary", "public"."round_info"."type" FROM "public"."round_info" WHERE (("public"."round_info"."tenant_id" = $1 AND "public"."round_info"."round_number" = $2) AND 1=1) LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4

UPDATE field_session SET disconnected_at=LEAST(now(),last_seen_at+interval $8) WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND client_id=$2 AND tab_id=$3 AND disconnected_at IS NULL AND (last_seen_at<=now()-interval $9 OR signature_key<>$4 OR block_id IS DISTINCT FROM $5::integer OR address_id IS DISTINCT FROM $6::integer OR round_number<>$7)

SELECT "public"."territory_block"."id", "public"."territory_block"."registration_status", "public"."territory_block"."block_id", "public"."territory_block"."territory_id", "public"."territory_block"."signature_id", "public"."territory_block"."tenant_id" FROM "public"."territory_block" LEFT JOIN "public"."block" AS "orderby_1_block" ON ("public"."territory_block"."block_id" = "orderby_1_block"."id") WHERE ("public"."territory_block"."tenant_id" = $1 AND "public"."territory_block"."territory_id" = $2 AND "public"."territory_block"."registration_status" <> $3 AND "public"."territory_block"."block_id" = $4) ORDER BY "orderby_1_block"."name" ASC OFFSET $5
SELECT "public"."block"."id", "public"."block"."name" FROM "public"."block" WHERE "public"."block"."id" IN ($1) OFFSET $2
SELECT "public"."address"."id", "public"."address"."name", "public"."address"."tenant_id", "public"."address"."zip_code" FROM "public"."address" WHERE "public"."address"."id" IN ($1,$2,$3) OFFSET $4
SELECT "public"."type"."id", "public"."type"."name", "public"."type"."tenant_id" FROM "public"."type" WHERE "public"."type"."id" IN ($1) OFFSET $2

SELECT "public"."signature"."id", "public"."signature"."key", "public"."signature"."expiration_date", "public"."signature"."token" FROM "public"."signature" WHERE "public"."signature"."id" IN ($1) OFFSET $2
SELECT "public"."address"."id", "public"."address"."name" FROM "public"."address" WHERE "public"."address"."id" IN ($1,$2,$3) OFFSET $4

UPDATE round SET 
        update_date = $1, 
        completed = $2, 
        completed_date = $3 
      WHERE house_id = $4 AND round_number = $5

SELECT "public"."territory_block_address"."id", "public"."territory_block_address"."registration_status", "public"."territory_block_address"."territory_block_id", "public"."territory_block_address"."address_id", "public"."territory_block_address"."tenant_id" FROM "public"."territory_block_address" WHERE ("public"."territory_block_address"."registration_status" <> $1 AND "public"."territory_block_address"."territory_block_id" IN ($2)) OFFSET $3

SELECT "public"."parameter"."id", "public"."parameter"."key", "public"."parameter"."value", "public"."parameter"."description", "public"."parameter"."tenant_id" FROM "public"."parameter" WHERE (("public"."parameter"."tenant_id" = $1 AND "public"."parameter"."key" = $2) AND 1=1) LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4

SELECT "public"."multi_tenancy"."id", "public"."multi_tenancy"."name", "public"."multi_tenancy"."city", "public"."multi_tenancy"."state", "public"."multi_tenancy"."phone" FROM "public"."multi_tenancy" WHERE ("public"."multi_tenancy"."id" = $1 AND 1=1) LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3

SELECT "public"."territory"."id", "public"."territory"."name", "public"."territory"."image_url" FROM "public"."territory" WHERE ("public"."territory"."id" = $1 AND "public"."territory"."tenant_id" = $2) LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4

SELECT "public"."change_request"."id", "public"."change_request"."entity", "public"."change_request"."action", "public"."change_request"."target_id" FROM "public"."change_request" WHERE ("public"."change_request"."tenant_id" = $1 AND "public"."change_request"."territory_id" = $2 AND "public"."change_request"."status" = $3 AND "public"."change_request"."block_id" = $4) OFFSET $5
